messages.subject: Workshop Geometric Morphometrics using R, Concepcion, Chile 2019
parts:
Dear Morphometricians

Just to remember you that the deadline for applications are the end of December 2018

The application are open for the course: "An Introduction to geometric morphometrics, a workshop using R" to be given by the team who created the "geomorph" package, Dr. Dean Adams, Dr. Mike Collyer and Dr. Antigoni Kaliontzopoulou.

This course will be in English language and it will be held at the Universidad de Concepción, Chile, on April 8-12, 2019.

The selection will be competitive according to CV and intention letter that must be sent to morf...@gmail.com, or hugobe...@gmail.com and previous knowledge on GM and using the R software will be a priority. 

The application period will be until December 30, 2018.  More details you can visit my  website: http://www.morphoshape.com

Best wishes

--

Dr. Hugo A. Benítez
